How would you prepare this information? Explain your approach in your own words. You do not need to write SQL.
solution_approach: I will join enrollments and assessments to conditionally sum Completed, Pending and Failed event amounts per enrollments.
schema: students(student_id PK, student_name, city, segment, joined_date); courses(course_id PK, course_name, category, status, base_value); enrollments(enrollment_id PK, student_id FK, course_id FK, enrollment_date, status, course_fee); assessments(assessment_id PK, enrollment_id FK, assessment_date, assessment_type, quantity, amount, status)
learner_question: Should every enrollment display Completed, Pending, and Failed totals even when some are zero?
manager_reply: Yes. Show all three status totals for every enrollment, using zero whenever no matching assessments exist.

business_scenario:
A college administrator wants to prepare an up-to-date review. The team has records of students, enrollments and assessments.

For each enrollment with assessments, select the one with the latest date. If several share that date, select the largest assessment number. Show its assessment number, enrollment number, date, type, recorded assessment points and status. Include all activity statuses and omit enrollments without activity. Arrange the list by enrollment number, smallest first.

How would you prepare this information? Explain your approach in your own words. You do not need to write SQL.
solution_approach: I will row number assessments partitioned by enrollment id from newest to oldest by assessment date and assessment id. I will keep row number 1 as the latest event.
schema: students(student_id PK, student_name, city, segment, joined_date); courses(course_id PK, course_name, category, status, base_value); enrollments(enrollment_id PK, student_id FK, course_id FK, enrollment_date, status, course_fee); assessments(assessment_id PK, enrollment_id FK, assessment_date, assessment_type, quantity, amount, status)
learner_question: If an enrollment has multiple assessments on its latest assessment date, which one should be selected?
manager_reply: Pick the assessment with the largest assessment number on that latest date, and omit enrollments without assessments.
